timeline.label: FDA inspection 1203954 ended 2023-04-25, classified VAI; classification letter 2023-07-10

explanation.headline: FDA's records trace our supply to a plant classified VAI 127 days before the shortage posting

sentences.text: FDA posted the cisplatin shortage on 2023-02-10 and as of 2026-10-21 it has been on the list for 44 months.
An FDA inspection of the Thymoorgan Pharmazie GmbH plant (FEI 3002320821) ended on 2022-10-06 and was classified VAI, 127 days before the shortage posting.
A subsequent inspection of the same plant ended on 2023-04-25 and was also classified VAI, with the classification letter dated 2023-07-10, 74 days after the shortage posting.
The plant is listed as a registered manufacturing site for a Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. cisplatin label (NDC 00143950401).
Earlier inspections of this plant in 2010, 2014, and 2019 were also classified VAI.
Corvale East holds 166 units at 9.3 units per day (18 days on hand) and Corvale General holds 270 units at 8.7 units per day (31 days on hand).

memory.text: Decision on cisplatin: transfer cisplatin between Corvale hospitals weekly instead of buying grey-market stock. Rationale: Grey-market offers were 6 to 10 times contract price with unverifiable pedigree (demo history). Approved by Jordan Hale, PharmD.

Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Q-22fbc9.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%cisplatin%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%cisplatin%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-7c3ca9.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('76aea034-6d58-4390-a164-36aa09c1f101', 'a440f077-46f6-4688-a209-65bce38d1c92', 'a32820f7-9ff6-4c13-a96a-4483a943fe82') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-e36018.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%cisplatin%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-de4de7.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%cisplatin%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-9d96f1.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%cisplatin%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%inject%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-de97cd.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('3002320821', '3009056604', '3004011473', '3003157498', '1450022', '3001229385') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-d83a60.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('3002320821', '3009056604', '3004011473', '3003157498', '1450022', '3001229385') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-f85351.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('3002320821', '3009056604') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('thymoorgan pharmazie', 'gland', 'pharmachemie')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-280df3.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('thymoorgan pharmazie', 'gland', 'pharmachemie', 'hikma', 'teva parenteral medicines') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%cisplatin%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-b4d99f.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('00143950401', '00703574711', '68083016201')

Q-f1b3c5.sql: SELECT s.item_key, s.description, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.ndc_match FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE p.ndc11 IS NULL AND lower(s.description) LIKE '%cisplatin%'
